hardware_operations_issued:
binary=/usr/bin/carnot
input_sha256=$(printf '%s\n' '/usr/bin/carnot --help' | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'CARNOT_EXP7231_BEGIN\n'
printf 'input_sha256=%s\n' "$input_sha256"
if [ ! -x "$binary" ]; then
    printf 'availability=missing\n'
    printf 'CARNOT_EXP7231_END\n'
    exit 3
fi
binary_sha256=$(sha256sum "$binary" | awk '{print $1}')
output_file=$(mktemp /tmp/carnot-exp7231.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$output_file"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
started_ns=$(date +%s%N)
timeout 60 "$binary" --help >"$output_file" 2>&1
workload_exit_code=$?
completed_ns=$(date +%s%N)
output_sha256=$(sha256sum "$output_file" | awk '{print $1}')
output_bytes=$(wc -c <"$output_file" | tr -d ' ')
output_base64=$(base64 <"$output_file" | tr -d '\n')
printf 'availability=available\n'
printf 'binary_sha256=%s\n' "$binary_sha256"
printf 'workload_exit_code=%s\n' "$workload_exit_code"
printf 'output_sha256=%s\n' "$output_sha256"
printf 'output_bytes=%s\n' "$output_bytes"
printf 'output_base64=%s\n' "$output_base64"
printf 'elapsed_ns=%s\n' "$((completed_ns - started_ns))"
printf 'CARNOT_EXP7231_END\n'
exit "$workload_exit_code"

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Only models actually invoked; [] for CPU/aggregation, mandated Qwen3.8 for every model task.
field_principles.board_continuity_complete_score: All three board dispositions, not all boards successful.
field_principles.board_rows: Board, latest source, terminal criterion, exact observation and next prerequisite.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: Record the actual UTC completion separately from the fixed execution date.
field_principles.device_power: Unknown until a device power measurement exists.
field_principles.device_speed: Unknown until a comparable device timing measurement exists.
field_principles.dispatch_receipt: Transport, binary, input, output and timing evidence for the one bounded attempt.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured monotonic work time; no padding or reclassification to evade a floor.
field_principles.execution_venue: Exactly host, kv260, gatemate or polarfire; the top-level orchestration here is host.
field_principles.experiment_id: A fixed ID binds this evidence to one task.
field_principles.field_principles: Annotate actual values in this map; do not wrap arbitrary dictionaries as principle/value records.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked_* verdict names failed check, upstream, field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.hardware_operations_issued: Exact bounded commands or empty list.
field_principles.hardware_performance_claimed: A CPU smoke and historical receipts do not establish performance.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete_ or complete: for completed findings; blocked_* for external absence. A failed acceptance gate forbids positive.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for the work actually executed; custom free text caused the Exp7208 quarantine.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Match actual generation, load-only, CPU or aggregation work and its duration floor.
field_principles.milestone: The milestone binds this result to the V636 execution contract.
field_principles.model_invoked: True only for actual model execution; upstream model outputs are cached evidence.
field_principles.operation_map: Host/board/FPGA/TSU work and unknown quantities distinguished.
field_principles.operator_state_receipt: GateMate physical change source or explicit absence.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Actual code, resource, identity and gate observations before expensive work.
field_principles.programmable_logic_sampling_claimed: PolarFire CPU execution is not FPGA sampling.
field_principles.purchases_or_vendor_contact: This audit does not buy hardware or contact a vendor.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze random choices before reading held-out outcomes.
field_principles.raw_dispatch_transcript_absence_reason: Explain null raw evidence without inventing a result.
field_principles.raw_dispatch_transcript_path: Actual PolarFire stdout/stderr and hashes, or null with a reason.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash exact source, inputs, settings and raw unit rows.
field_principles.rows: Per unit/arm/seed metric, error and abstention for every comparison; retain full denominators.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260912 and record actual UTC timestamps, never copy an upstream run date.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Planned, attempted, completed, censored and independent units; no silent removal.
field_principles.schema: A versioned schema makes incompatible readers fail closed.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Bind code, source documents, manifests and raw evidence to claims.
field_principles.spec_refs: Requirement and scenario IDs connect tests and evidence to this contract.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record the actual UTC start separately from the fixed execution date.
field_principles.status: Write a terminal artifact only when done or externally blocked; running checkpoints use a different path.
field_principles.task_id: The roadmap task identity prevents another task from supplying this result.
field_principles.topology_fit: Unknown until an explicit device topology mapping exists.
field_principles.verdict_class: Closed enum positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. partial means unfinished own work only.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when correctness authority is reused as the verifier; independent code alone is not distinct authority.
